name_input: SWASTICO PIPE & TUBE PRIVATE LIMITED; SWASTICO ALLOYS & PIPES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export rows found. ImportKey page for the primary entity shows only inbound cargo: "2025-02-18 | SONHA SSP VIETNAM SOLE MEMBER COMPA | SWASTICO PIPE & TUBE PRIVATE LIMITED | STAINLESS STEEL COLD ROLLED COILS, GRADE- 316L, SIZE- 2.4*620*C | TAN CANG CAI MEP T, Vietnam -> MUNDRA SEA, India | HS 72193320 | BOL 8422192". All 5 visible rows are imports into India (origin Vietnam/Indonesia/China, destination Mundra/Mumbai), i.e. the company is the BUYER of raw stainless coil, not the shipper. Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 26 Records detected" but only 5 rows are rendered in the free view; the ?type=export variant returned the identical import dataset, so zero export records were observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split could be retrieved. thetenders.com search returned HTTP 404; volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403 (blocked). No domestic supply record was seen, but absence of a retrievable source is not proof of absence — hence 'unknown', not 'none_found'.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the customs evidence proves this company is an IMPORTER of stainless steel cold/hot rolled coils (HS 72193320, 72193390, 72191300) from Vietnam (Sonha SSP Vietnam), Indonesia (I M R Metallurgical Resources AG) and China (Jowin Industrial Limited), latest record 2025-02-18, BOL 8422192. This is consistent with a downstream pipe/tube mill at Plot No. 438, Manjusar GIDC, Gujarat, but it is NOT evidence of export shipments. No export bill of lading, no destination country outside India, and no HS 722490/730441/730630 shipment line was found in any accessible source. The declared HS codes (722490 semi-finished alloy steel, 730441/730630 stainless and other welded tube) are plausible for the company's product line but were not corroborated by any shipment record — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the code should be treated as declared, unverified. Second entity 'SWASTICO ALLOYS & PIPES PRIVATE LIMITED': both slug variants ('swastico-alloys-pipes-private-limited' and 'swastico-alloys-and-pipes-private-limited') returned empty ImportKey shells with no shipment rows at all — no trade activity of any kind observed for that name. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in any accessible source; not estimated). Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the whole session (connection refused), so discovery relied on direct URL fetches only — coverage is therefore partial and a paid Volza/Eximpedia view could change the export verdict. Bottom line: no trace of supply shipments found on the export side; domestic side unverified.
